title: Wastewater Sample Processing with Nanotrap® Microbiome A Particles
author: Dilip Abraham

steps.title: Sample Transport and Preparation
steps.instruction: Transport wastewater grab samples collected in 50 mL centrifuge tubes in cold chain at 4 °C. Upon receipt, allow samples to sit on a tube rack at room temperature for 10 minutes to let large aggregates settle.

steps.title: Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer 40 mL of clear supernatant into a new 50 mL centrifuge tube using a serological pipette, ensuring the sediment is not disturbed.

steps.title: Reagent Addition and Mixing
steps.instruction: Add ER2 Enhancer reagent and Nanotrap® A particles to the supernatant and mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL of ER2 Enhancer reagent to the supernatant, invert 2-3 times, and mix thoroughly.
Add 600 µL of Nanotrap® A particles and invert mix 2-3 times.

steps.title: Particle Incubation and Separation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture and use a magnetic stand to isolate the particles.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Place the tube on a 50 mL magnetic stand for 10 minutes to allow Nanotrap® particles to settle.

steps.title: Supernatant Removal
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet; use a pipette to remove all remaining supernatant if necessary.

steps.title: Pellet Resuspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet with buffer and controls. Note: Extraction must be carried out on the same day; do not freeze the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnetic rack.
Add 700 µL of InhibitEX buffer, 1 µL of 1/10 diluted SPC, and 1 µL of 1/10 diluted RNA-MS2 control to each particle pellet.
Resuspend the pellet by vortexing the tube briefly.

steps.title: Secondary Incubation and Separation
steps.instruction: Transfer the suspension to a microcentrifuge tube for further processing.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the suspension into a 1.7 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Place the microcentrifuge tubes on a 1.5 mL magnetic separation rack until the Nanotrap® particles have settled and the solution is clear.

steps.title: Final Supernatant Collection
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube containing approximately 370 mg of acid-washed glass beads and discard the pellet.
